title: Merlin command buffer (experiment ABI v0.1)
description: Strict JSON Schema for the target-independent command buffer a package must emit. Mirrors merlin/schemas/command_buffer.schema.yaml but validated programmatically and fail-closed.

dtype.description: Tensor dtype — open vocabulary validated by the quant_formats registry (formerly a narrower enum than capsule.schema, which made a microscaling target self-reject its own operands); not a hardcoded list.

base.description: DRAM byte address the kernel loads this input from / stores this output to. The program oracle preloads inputs and reads the output at these addresses, so they MUST match the emitted kernel's loads/stores. Optional: if omitted, the harness assigns a canonical layout (capsule_dram).

physical.description: physical->logical readback layout the backend wrote (e.g. {"unstack_row_halves": 2}); optional

preload_b64.description: harness-attached input bytes (base64); not emitted by the package

output_dtype.description: Output dtype — open vocabulary validated by the quant_formats registry (same as the tensor dtype above).
